semantic.justification: Source decomposition of sw/source/writerfilter/rtftok/rtfdocumentimpl.ts: RtfParagraphState, RtfState, RtfParagraph, RtfRun, RtfBlock, RtfSectionPage, RtfTableRow, DEFAULT_CHARACTER, RTF_UNDERLINE_STYLES, hasRtfUnderlineControl, DEFAULT_PARAGRAPH, SKIPPED_DESTINATIONS, STYLE_PROPERTY_CONTROLS, CHARACTER_PROPERTY_CONTROLS, createRtfTabStops, createRtfLineSpacing, equalCharacter, resolveRtfRunAttributes, equalControls, getRtfFieldCommandParts, parseRtfHyperlinkInstruction, fromRtfNfc, RtfDocumentImplContext. Existing native algorithms operate on the original class instance and retain original state, method ordering and observable behavior. No independent scanner or parser state is introduced. Full upstream and compiled differential parity remain unverified. S3HW1E native paragraph item dispatch exposes inherited stylesheet tab definitions without redundant body copies. The existing RTF tab kind/leader handlers are now admitted in style entries as well as body state, matching unconditional tab attribute ownership in pinned RTFDocumentImpl::dispatchFlag; no empty direct tab override is fabricated. S3HW1E named character-style integration: stylesheet cs entries materialize actual SwCharFormat owners separately from paragraph collections, resolve same-family forward parents, and apply represented character properties. Real SwFormatCharFormat/SwTextCharFormat hints retain selected style identity, direct-property precedence and group/plain restoration; the native current character-style index remains distinct from the selected rStyle reference for failed lookups. RTF OutputTextCharFormat emits original cs IDs before repeated effective properties, as the source requires. Character-style positive baseline percentages are kept separate from paragraph automatic superscript. The represented RTFSprms getDefaultSPRM character families reset absent run bold/italic/underline/font/height/color properties present in the flattened style reference; non-defaulted strikeout/highlight/escapement/kerning inherit. Plain clears direct kerning rather than inventing a false direct override. Native style-default helper compiled unchanged with original generated OOXML IDs under ASan/UBSan yields9 defaults among35 queried tokens; scalar/nested value carriers are not full RTFValue/RTFSprms or mapper ABI. Existing run-projection/string-sink bindings remain explicit; complete native property graph, duplicate style-index semantics, linked styles, paragraph-style cs/s cross-family behavior, CJK/CTL import association, script/bidi and remaining whole-filter obligations are unverified. Temporary imported automatic style handles/sets are disposed, and export run item sets now use generator-scoped ownership. S3HW1E native property-presence checkpoint: RTFReferenceProperties now derives from genuine SvRefBase; RTFValue.getProperties returns an actual owned ReferencePointer backed by existing tools::SvRef. Mapper nested-property consumers release only these returned pointer temporaries in finally blocks; borrowed Stream.props and existing host-owned OOXML references retain their contracts. RTF materialization uses an actual SwXTextDocument/DomainMapper and real SwPaM ranges; admitted bold, italic, font size, ASCII font, color, underline/color and kerning resource trees reach the original PropertyMap and SetPropertyValues with source insertTextPortion NOFORMATATTR, preserving explicit native item presence instead of a value-difference filter. Original raw style rPr references remain distinct from materialized SwAttrSet ancestry; flattening copies rPr children without following parents. Default style0 insertion, first-entry table insertion and numeric entry order follow source. Parent/follow controls capture currently known source names, preserving empty non-forced RTFValue query zero (WRITER206). Targeted real-owner tests cover later style edits, parent references, script scope and exceptional pointer-return cleanup. Full native parser-property state, style application through native style-table/UNO owners, non-admitted character and paragraph/table property families, replay/substreams, complete script import/export and earlier TXT/RTF/Markdown/HTML obligations remain open. Existing named-style materialization and remaining callbacks are not certified as full upstream contracts; duplicate-ID/name selection is unverified. No full native Writer/mapper ABI or whole-filter parity promotion. S3HW1E RTF strike/highlight checkpoint: original explicit SourceDocumentType now selects RTF integer highlight colors versus OOXML palette tokens, and character-style highlights follow the original mapper exclusion. RTF parser groups and emitted run snapshots own genuine RTFSprms copies for strike/dstrike/highlight; ordered independent toggle values, overwrite positions, native COW and native normalization replace the collapsed strike DTO as the materialization input. Plain clears the admitted modifier state. Actual style/run mapper vectors retain direct zero-valued items and native equal-value deduplication. Existing difference-based strike/highlight item creation was removed; escapement remains on its prior path pending a concrete position/inheritance fix. Actual group members and all queued paragraph/table snapshots release at the atomic reader lifetime boundary, including parse errors. Tests exercise valid RTF inputs, inherited/direct values and source-profile colors, rather than requiring unrelated module API completeness. Whole native parser state and unconsumed factory/UNO/module operations are not claimed complete and are not independent filter completion gates.
